OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_AUTO.description: Whether the connector should run automatically when an entity is created or updated.

CONNECTOR_MAX_TLP.description: The highest TLP of the entities the connector is allowed to enrich. Entities marked with a higher TLP are skipped and never sent to the external source.

RST_IOC_LOOKUP_BASE_URL.description: The RST Cloud API base URL.

RST_IOC_LOOKUP_UPDATE_CONFIDENCE.description: Whether to set the indicator confidence to the RST Cloud source score.

RST_IOC_LOOKUP_UPDATE_SCORE.description: Whether to update the score of the observable or indicator.

RST_IOC_LOOKUP_UPDATE_VALID_FROM.description: Whether to move the indicator `valid_from` to the last seen date (and shift `valid_until` accordingly).

RST_IOC_LOOKUP_SCORE_TYPE.description: The RST Cloud score to use: `last` (score on the last seen day), `first` (score on the first seen day) or `total` (decayed score).

RST_IOC_LOOKUP_UPDATE_DESCRIPTION_ACTION.description: How to merge the RST Cloud description into the existing one: `overwrite`, `append` or `prepend`.

RST_IOC_LOOKUP_DETECTION_FLAG_THRESHOLD.description: Score from which the indicator detection flag is set to true (below, it is set to false). `0` leaves the detection flag unchanged.

RST_IOC_LOOKUP_LABEL_FORMAT.description: Label format: `short` (suffixes such as `_group` or `_ransomware` removed) or `long` (labels kept as returned by RST Cloud).

RST_IOC_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT.description: The RST Cloud API request timeout, in seconds.
